The bigger question, though, is why the Q Society – and so many others on the anti-Islam right of politics – gets so agitated about sharia law and halal certification. “So you have this irony of them expressing pseudo concern for things like women’s rights and the treatment of homosexuals under Islam,” Roose says, “from a group of people that traditionally have not been at the forefront of advocating for such things. The Q Society, says Jones, is very sensitive to the charge of racism, and its leadership makes a point of citing non-white critics of Islam. Edmonton Police Commission Appointments Investigation. The Edmonton Police Service (EPS) has formally asked Alberta Minister of Public Safety Mike Ellis and Emergency Services to investigate two recent appointments to the Edmonton Police Commission (EPC), citing significant concerns about their suitability for the roles. “The governance relationship between city council and the EPC is vital to maintaining public trust and ensuring effective oversight of the police service,” the EPS said in its statement. Minister Ellis told the Western Standard that the relationship betwen the EPS, City of Edmonton Council, and the EPC had become "increasingly dysfunctional.". These are important issues, and it is our hope that our inquiry will foster a stronger relationship between EPS, the Edmonton Police Commission, Edmonton City Council, and most importantly, the people of Edmonton.".
